items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: Elton Pointer, and Joe Watkins on the drums. Yeah, we had one of the best rhythm sessions I think they had on.

ctx.x: Yes I do. And we had, I'll tell you, we had one of the best rhythm sessions they had. George Moods, George Moods, yeah. Elton Pointer, and Joe Watkins on the drums. Yeah, we had one of the best rhythm sessions I think they had on. Yeah. Well see my banjo playing is cold and heavy comp. And when they tell me to get off, I get off. That's where I do it now. That's where the people, these people take a light to my playing because I play it different from everybody. I'm trying to get up there and try to play solo,…
You make a couple of chords, not strum them, but just finger them. I'd like to see how your fingers... Do you want to finger on a chord? Do you want anything?
